The proposed change meets all the requirements under the Planning and Development Act 2007 and the dedicated lands regulation 2009.
Utility agencies have been consulted and SAS Power requires an easement.
Public notice was provided through newspaper at city hall postings and the city's website.
If approved by the buffer strip will be sold to the National Affordable Housing Corporation for $250 plus GST with all closure related costs covered by the applicant.
Seal proceeds will go to the dedicated road reserve which funds property purchases for roadway projects and developed.
The administration confirms the buffer is not needed to separate incompatible land uses and that no social or environmental applications have been identified.
